title: symphyotrichum carolinianum
intro: Symphyotrichum carolinianum, commonly known as Carolina aster, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum carolinianum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and possess anti-cancer properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
